description: A US-listed company's reported numbers, from the financial data tagged in its SEC filings (10-K and 10-Q; not the reports' text, which is filing_text): revenue, gross and operating profit, net income, diluted EPS, operating cash flow, capital spending, free cash flow, R&D, cash, long-term debt, assets, liabilities, equity and share count, for the last few fiscal years or quarters, with growth and net margin, and its latest filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K with item numbers). Every value links to the filing it came from. Look a company up by ticker (AAPL), name or SEC CIK. Use for 'how is X doing', 'is X profitable', 'how much debt does X have', due diligence on a public company. Only companies that file with the SEC; not private companies or crypto projects.

company.description: Ticker (AAPL), company name, or SEC CIK
